label: Idealista Scraper
title: Idealista Scraper: Spain, Portugal & Italy Listings
metaDescription: Extract Idealista property data from Spain, Portugal and Italy past the 1,800-listing limit: prices, specs, photos and agency contacts.
intro: Paste an Idealista search for Spain, Portugal or Italy and get every listing (past Idealista's 1,800-listing limit) with price, specs, photos and agency contact.
useCases: Collect every listing in a city, not just the first 1,800
Compare prices and sizes across districts
Build lead lists of agencies by area

faq.q: How is this different from Idealista Scraper API?
faq.a: Idealista Scraper API charges per property returned, also covers France, and accepts drawn-map and multi-zone links. This one is listed as free on the Apify Store and covers Spain, Portugal and Italy.
